summary: Open-source Zapier alternative for building AI automations with a no-code builder, 200+ app integrations that also work as MCP servers.

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: Activepieces is an all-in-one AI automation platform. Non-technical users build flows in a visual builder with loops, branches, retries, HTTP and code steps, while developers extend it with 'pieces', type-safe TypeScript npm packages for each app. Every piece is also available as an MCP server for Claude Desktop, Cursor or Windsurf, and native AI pieces and an AI SDK help build agents.
sixtySeconds.problem: Automation tools like Zapier are closed and costly at scale. Activepieces is open source and can be self-hosted, even on an isolated network.
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for a friendly builder, a large open MCP toolkit, human-in-the-loop steps and self-hosting.
requirements: See the official installation guide (self-hosting options)

overview: The README doesn't list install commands; it links to the installation overview in the Activepieces docs for self-hosting, and to activepieces.com for the cloud.
Flows support approvals and delays, chat and form triggers, versioning, templates and an Ask AI helper in code steps. There are 200+ pieces, many contributed by the community.
The Community Edition is MIT licensed; enterprise features are under a commercial license.
